metadata.case_name: KO CHU KEUNG v. TEMMUK ENGINEERING CO., LIMITED AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: Construction worker doing welding works at the foundation and superstructure of 53 Perkins Road, Jardine’s Lookout, Hong Kong
plaintiff.occupation_after: Part-time petrol attendant at a gas station

injuries.description: 20 cm laceration over his right scalp
source: Physical examination showed 20 cm laceration over his right scalp with a 10 cm × 4 cm contaminated wound over the right leg with exposed bone. X-ray showed fracture right tibia and fibula.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of head

injuries.description: Gustilo 3A open fracture right tibia and fibula
source: The diagnosis was Gustilo 3A open fracture right tibia and fibula.

injuries.description: Injury to his right arm caused by the oxy-acetylene welding set
source: At the same time, the oxy-acetylene welding set was continually turned on,and injured his right arm.

manifestations.description: itchiness especially in summer at the right anterior scar, and also scar on scrubbing and on pressure
on and off pain in the right mid shin (leg area)
pain on exercise e.g. playing basketball, jumping/hopping, squatting and running increases pain; running for 15 minutes needs to slow down and/or walking
on gentle bumping at the fracture site and the scar increases in pain
some degrees of weakness are found in the right lower limb but he requires no walking aids
pain of bumping at the right anterior knee scar as well as squatting and kneeing
prominent scar on right calf which at times would be itchy and painful

treatments_received: intramedullary nailing of the right tibia
removal of implanted device from tibia and fibula (plate, screws, nail and locking bolts removed)

losses.description: Prominent scar on right calf which at times is itchy and painful
Reduced ability to stand, walk, squat, climb and reduced endurance; requires intermittent breaks of 15 minutes after each 1.5 hours of work when performing welding duties

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Exercise (e.g. playing basketball, running, jumping/hopping) increases pain with expected reduction in performance and enjoyment

comparable_cases.case_name: David John Slater v Commissioner of Police
Lai Chi Ming v Ng Pak Chuen & Anor
comparable_cases.injury_description: Fractures of his right tibia and fibula bones, and laceration to that foot; substantial scarring of the lower leg; including removal of implanted screws; 3 operations
